title: Signal Graph Execution Inspector Demo

launch.notes: Runs the existing multichannel, sidechain, multi-bus, and spatial boundary descriptor and acceptance lanes and records one machine-readable receipt.

scenarios.title: Graph Execution Inspector Bootstrap
scenarios.summary: Captures canonical graph execution meaning across multichannel layout, sidechain routing, multi-bus topology, and spatial execution through one repo-owned inspection surface.

evidence.notes: This bootstrap surface wraps the existing graph-routing boundary descriptors and acceptance lanes without inventing a DAW shell, visual graph editor, or tutorial UI.

known_exclusions: DSP processing-lab and analysis feature-inspector demos remain deferred to later g09.013 planning decisions.
This surface proves graph execution meaning through existing boundary families and does not claim media browser or product-shell breadth.
This demo does not redesign graph/runtime behavior; it reuses the existing proof surfaces.
expected_checks: The receipt captures machine-readable multichannel, sidechain, multi-bus, and spatial boundary descriptors.
The receipt records that the existing multichannel, sidechain, multi-bus, and spatial acceptance lanes completed successfully.
The receipt keeps graph execution meaning explicit instead of flattening the seam into a generic product demo.
signal-primitives and signal-graph only move to live demo coverage because this manifest and receipt exist.
